objective: Measure warm TypeScript HMR update latency with the pinned TSRS worker available
method: 30 sequential atomic replacements of one self-accepted .ts entry after initial load; each sample runs from just before writing the replacement through the updated generation's stdout line
entry: temporary self-accepted ESM TypeScript entry with one annotated numeric parameter and return type
scope: Warm updates for one small typed TypeScript ESM file on this host; not a multi-module, cold-start, cross-host, full-checker-compatibility, or production claim.
